dedupe_keys.name: greece country scale stochastic wildfire simulation dataset fsim fire res

description: This dataset gives the first country-scale stochastic wildfire simulation for Greece, produced with the Large Fire Simulator (FSim) using the minimum travel time fire spread algorithm. Outputs include burn probability, conditional flame length and fire intensity, ignition probability and simulated fire perimeters across 23 pyromes, regions of similar vegetation and climate, using about 100 metre fuel models, canopy base height and canopy bulk density from the EU Horizon 2020 FIRE-RES project, corrected with local knowledge. Version 2 was published on 11 November 2025 by the University of the Aegean with the Agricultural University of Athens, the Forest Science and Technology Centre of Catalonia and the National Observatory of Athens. The data, about 1.6 GB as file geodatabase, raw rasters and layer files, are available free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: results depend on fuel model and weather assumptions and are probabilistic. It supports wildfire exposure analysis of power lines, roads, settlements and water catchments in Greece; a related record is the USFS Wildfire Hazard Potential map, also built on FSim.
